claim: The effectiveness of communication channel resets in improving performance increases with task complexity (number of suspects) in multi-agent collaboration.
falsifier: In a multi-agent collaboration task with variable number of suspects, apply communication channel resets and measure performance gains relative to baseline for each suspect count to test if gains increase with complexity.

conditions: when one or two resets are allowed
exclusions: limited to the WhoDunitEnv environment and the range of suspects tested (15, 20, 25)

title: Task complexity–performance gain from communication principle
